title: Counting to Ten
logline: At a dry-zone paddy store during harvest, a measurer fills basket after basket by hand, calling each count aloud, never rushing and never losing his place.
human_question: How does counting, of grain or of breath, keep an ordinary body steady through a long working day?

premise.story: One day at a paddy store during harvest, following the measurer, the farmers waiting on the tally, and the store's own pace, told through the real pressure of the season's income.
premise.place: A rural paddy store or threshing floor at harvest time in the dry zone.
premise.experience: The measure filled and levelled, straw and stones flicked out, numbers called steadily hour after hour, bags stacking, and farmers watching a count that decides their season.

concept_links.why: The source's own image for slow, steady counting is a paddy measurer filling a measure and calling each one, discarding the rubbish, neither rushing nor dawdling. This is mindfulness of breathing's own method of attention, transposed from breath to grain.
The steady rhythm of a working body through a long day, kept going by mind, food and the day's heat, is the same ground the four origins of matter describe.

what_camera_could_observe: The measurer filling and levelling the measure
Straw and stones flicked out, numbers called aloud
Farmers watching the tally that decides their season's income
The day's total reached, and reactions to it
what_must_be_real: The actual harvest, real prices and real stakes for the farmers involved. The counting itself must not be staged, slowed or repeated for the camera.

possible_arc.opening: The first baskets of a long harvest day.
possible_arc.turn: The count nearly lost in the noise and heat, then recovered.
possible_arc.ending_open: The day's total, and what it actually means for the farmers waiting.

requirements: An active paddy store using hand measuring at harvest time
A measurer and farmers willing to be filmed during a real harvest day
Correct timing within the harvest calendar

suggestions.name: Paddy stores of the North Central rice-growing districts
suggestions.why: A well-known dry-zone rice-growing area with active harvest-season paddy trading.
suggestions.season_notes: Timed to the maha or yala harvest season; needs local confirmation.
suggestions.verify: A specific store, its continued use of hand measuring and willingness to be filmed are unverified.

risks: Nostalgia for manual methods that ignores real debt and price pressure on farmers
Turning a livelihood into a meditation metaphor
drop_if: No harvest or hand measuring actually happening during the filming window
No store or farmers willing to be filmed

connections.note: Both watch attention keep a tired body going through a long stretch of work, one through the night, one through a harvest day.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
